row.evidence: Zscaler's pricing page lists the Essentials Platform and Zscaler Platform bundles with no prices (contact experts for bundle pricing), and its ZIA help says Zscaler supports only SCIM version 2.0 and SAML must be used as your authentication method to use SCIM for provisioning.
row.notes: Quote-only: Zscaler names two platform bundles (Essentials Platform, Zscaler Platform) with SAML and 'Multiple IdP, API Access' ticked on both, but publishes no prices and does not list SCIM on the pricing page, so under rule 6a the row is gated at low confidence. Microsoft's Entra tutorial for the Zscaler ZNet gallery app says the SCIM API is for accounts with the Enterprise package (IdP page, possibly outdated). New row. Researched for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA): SCIM 2.0 needs SAML; Users, Groups, Bulk, Schemas, ResourceTypes, ServiceProviderConfig; PUT and PATCH; active=false disables and DELETE removes; 5 requests/second; usernames must use a preregistered domain. Okta OIN, Entra gallery and Google Workspace apps provision; Google has no group push. ZIA cloud service API (users, groups, departments, admin audit logs) must be enabled by Zscaler Support.

plans.name: Zscaler Platform
plans.notes: Marked RECOMMENDED on the pricing page.

auth.token_source: Zscaler Admin Console > Administration > Identity > Internet & SaaS > Internet Authentication Settings > Identity Providers > Edit IdP > Enable SCIM Provisioning (Generate Token)

deprovision.notes: active=false disables the user; DELETE /Users removes the user from the Zscaler user database (used when users are deleted in the directory).

limitations.text: The username's domain must be preregistered with Zscaler before users can be created.
A user can be in at most 128 groups.
SCIM requires SAML authentication and is not supported with Active Directory or OpenLDAP user repositories; SAML auto-provisioning (JIT) must be turned off.
Google Workspace provisioning does not support Group Push.

scim.notes: Researched for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), the main product. ZPA and ZIdentity (Authentication Service) have their own SCIM docs on help.zscaler.com that were not researched in depth.

endpoints.purpose: List users (filter by name, department or group)

limitations.text: Cloud service API availability is limited and must be enabled by Zscaler Support; the API-key method needs an API subscription.

user_api.notes: Both bundles list 'API Access' on the pricing page, but the API docs say the cloud service API must be enabled by Zscaler Support. Per-endpoint rate limits are in a separate API Rate Limit Summary that was not read. Newer OneAPI endpoints were not researched.

okta.notes: OIN app 'Zscaler Internet Access' ticks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking.

entra.notes: Gallery app (Microsoft's tutorial is titled Zscaler ZNet).

google.notes: Create, Update and Deactivate; no Group Push.

onelogin.notes: Zscaler publishes only a SAML configuration guide for OneLogin.

fallbacks.other_sync: Directory sync from Active Directory/LDAP (migration to SCIM documented)

conflicts.text: The pricing page shows SAML and multiple-IdP support on both bundles with no SCIM plan named, while Microsoft's Entra tutorial says the Zscaler ZNet SCIM API is available for accounts with the Enterprise package.

open_questions: Which bundle or SKU includes SCIM is not on the pricing page; Microsoft's tutorial says Enterprise package.
Whether disabling or deleting a user frees a licence or ends sessions is not documented.
SCIM token expiry is not documented.
ZIA cloud service API base URL and per-endpoint rate limits were not captured (API Rate Limit Summary not read).
ZPA and ZIdentity SCIM behaviour may differ and was not researched in depth; JumpCloud and OneLogin provisioning not checked.
